arxiv-2012-08773.creator: Jiaxiang Hao
arxiv-2012-08773.description: Abstract In the sentiment analysis task, predicting the sentiment tendency of a sentence is an important branch. Previous research focused more on sentiment analysis in English, for example, analyzing the sentiment tendency of sentences based Valence, Arousal, Dominance of sentences. the emotional tendency are different between two languages.

arxiv-2208-05193.title: A Possibility of
arxiv-2208-05193.creator: Determining the WIMP Mass by
arxiv-2208-05193.description: Abstract In this article, as an extension of our study on the angular distribution of the recoil flux of WIMP–scattered target nuclei, we demonstrate a possibility of determining the mass of incident halo WIMPs by using or combining “ridge–crater” structures of the angular recoil–energy spectra with different target nuclei observed in directional direct Dark Matter detection experiments.

arxiv-2307-16869.title: Anomalous noise spectra in a spin-exchange-relaxation-free alkali-metal vapor
arxiv-2307-16869.creator: K. Mouloudakis, J. Kong, A. Sierant, E. Arkin, M. Hernández Ruiz, R. Jiménez-Martínez, M. W. Mitchell
arxiv-2307-16869.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by K. Mouloudakis, J. Kong, A. Sierant, E. Arkin, M. Hernández Ruiz, R. Jiménez-Martínez, M. W. Mitchell. We perform spin-noise spectroscopy on an unpolarized 87 Rb \rm{Rb} vapor in the spin-exchange-relaxation-free (SERF) regime. We observe noise spectral distributions that deviate strongly from Lorentzian models that accurately describe lower-density regimes.

arxiv-2404-14166.title: Partial algebras and implications of (weak) matrix properties
arxiv-2404-14166.creator: Michael Hoefnagel, Pierre-Alain Jacqmin
arxiv-2404-14166.description: Abstract Matrix properties are a type of property of categories which includes the ones of being Mal’tsev, arithmetical, majority, unital, strongly unital and subtractive. Recently, an algorithm has been developed to determine implications M ⇒ lex ∗ N \mathrm{M}\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{lex}_{\ast}}\mathrm{N} between them.

arxiv-2502-20621.title: EPhishCADE: A Privacy-Aware Multi-Dimensional Framework for Email Phishing Campaign Detection
arxiv-2502-20621.creator: Wei Kang, Nan Wang, Jang Seung, Shuo Wang, Alsharif Abuadbba
arxiv-2502-20621.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wei Kang, Nan Wang, Jang Seung, Shuo Wang, Alsharif Abuadbba. Phishing attacks, typically carried out by email, remain a significant cybersecurity threat with attackers creating legitimate-looking websites to deceive recipients into revealing sensitive information or executing harmful actions.

arxiv-2503-17187.title: Hankel Determinants for Convolution of Power Series: An Extension of Cigler’s Results
arxiv-2503-17187.creator: Feihu Liu, Ying Wang, Yingrui Zhang, Zihao Zhang, Email address: liufeihu7476@163.com, Email address: wangying2019@ncwu.edu.cn § Email address: zyrzuhe@126.com P Email address: zihao-zhang@foxmail.com
arxiv-2503-17187.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Feihu Liu, Ying Wang, Yingrui Zhang, Zihao Zhang, Email address: liufeihu7476@163.com, Email address: wangying2019@ncwu.edu.cn § Email address: zyrzuhe@126.com P Email address: zihao-zhang@foxmail.com. Cigler considered certain shifted Hankel determinants of convolution powers of Catalan numbers and conjectured identities for these determinants. Recently, Fulmek gave a bijective proof of Cigler’s conjecture. Cigler then provided a computational proof.

arxiv-2505-16717.title: ON THE ANGULAR ANISOTROPY OF THE DISTRIBUTION FUNCTION OF RADIATING PARTICLES IN RELATIVISTIC JETS
arxiv-2505-16717.creator: T.I. Khalilov, V.S. Beskin, V.I. Pariev
arxiv-2505-16717.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by T.I. Khalilov, V.S. Beskin, V.I. Pariev. The observed power-law spectra of relativistic jets from active galactic nuclei clearly indicate a synchrotron mechanism of radiation by particles that similarly possess a power-law energy spectrum. However, the issue of their angular anisotropy has not been given sufficient attention until recently, although the example of the solar wind (where a strongly magnetized wind is realized in a similar way) shows the importance of taking this circumstance into account.

arxiv-2505-19503.title: Locality-Aware Zero-Shot Human-Object Interaction Detection
arxiv-2505-19503.creator: Sanghyun Kim Deunsol Jung Minsu Cho
arxiv-2505-19503.description: Abstract Recent methods for zero-shot Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection typically leverage the generalization ability of large Vision-Language Model (VLM), i.e., CLIP, on unseen categories, showing impressive results on various zero-shot settings. However, existing methods struggle to adapt CLIP representations for human-object pairs, as CLIP tends to overlook fine-grained information necessary for distinguishing interactions.

arxiv-2509-04556.title: Domain coarsening in fractonic systems: a cascade of critical exponents
arxiv-2509-04556.creator: Jacopo Gliozzi, Federico Balducci, Giuseppe De Tomasi
arxiv-2509-04556.description: Abstract We study the dynamics of domain growth when multipole moments of the order parameter are conserved. Following a quench into the ordered phase of the Ising model, the typical size of domains grows with time as R ⁡ ( t ) ∼ t 1 / 2 R(t)\sim t^{1/2} in the absence of conserved quantities.

arxiv-2601-02005.title: Euclid : Improving redshift distribution reconstruction using a deep-to-wide transfer function Thanks: This paper is published on behalf of the Euclid Consortium.
arxiv-2601-02005.creator: Y. Kang, S. Paltani, W. G. Hartley, M. Bolzonella, A. H. Wright, F. Dubath, F. J. Castander, D. C. Masters, W. d’Assignies, H. Hildebrandt, O. Ilbert, M. Manera, W. Roster, S. A. Stanford, N. Aghanim, B. Altieri, S. Andreon, N. Auricchio, H. Aussel, C. Baccigalupi, M. Baldi, S. Bardelli, P. Battagli
arxiv-2601-02005.description: Abstract The Euclid mission of the European Space Agency seeks to understand the Universe’s expansion history and the nature of dark energy, through measurements of cosmic shear. This requires a very accurate estimate of the true redshift distribution of the galaxies, with the systematic error in the mean redshift satisfying σ ⟨ z ⟩ < 0.

arxiv-2601-11056.title: Banach lattices with upper p p -estimates: Renorming and factorization
arxiv-2601-11056.creator: E. García-Sánchez, D. H. Leung, M. A. Taylor, P. Tradacete
arxiv-2601-11056.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by E. García-Sánchez, D. H. Leung, M. A. Taylor, P. Tradacete. The notions of p p -convexity and concavity are fundamental tools for studying Banach lattices, as they partition the class of Banach lattices into a scale of spaces with L p L_{p} -like properties. Upper and lower p p -estimates provide a refinement of this scale, modeled by the Lorentz spaces L p , ∞ L_{p,\infty} and L p , 1 L_{p,1} , respectively.

pmc-10726377.title: Metformin: A Potential Treatment for Acne, Hidradenitis Suppurativa and Rosacea
pmc-10726377.creator: Minah CHO, Yu Ri WOO, Sang Hyun CHO, Jeong Deuk LEE, Hei Sung KIM
pmc-10726377.description: Metformin is a widely used drug for treatment of diabetes mellitus, due to its safety and efficacy. In addition to its role as an antidiabetic drug, numerous beneficial effects of metformin have enabled its use in various diseases. Considering the anti-androgenic, anti-angiogenic, anti-fibrotic and antioxidant properties of metformin, it may have the potential to improve chronic inflammatory skin diseases.

pmc-11570478.title: FastAd: A versatile toolkit for rapid generation of single adenoviruses or diverse adenoviral vector libraries
pmc-11570478.creator: Shao-Chia Lu, Yi-Yuan Lee, Felix GM Andres, Daniel A Moyer, Michael A Barry
pmc-11570478.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Adenoviruses (Ads) are potent gene delivery vectors for in vitro and in vivo applications. However, current methods for their construction are time-consuming and inefficient, limiting their rapid production and utility in generating complex genetic libraries. Here, we introduce FastAd, a rapid and easy-to-use technology for inserting recombinant “donor” DNA directly into infectious “receiver” Ads in mammalian cells by the concerted action of two efficient recombinases: Cre and Bxb1.

pmc-12526070.title: Eating Habits, Physical Activity, Body Composition and Cardiorespiratory Fitness in University Students: A Cross- Sectional Study
pmc-12526070.creator: Edyta Kwilosz, Monika Musijowska, Katarzyna Badora-Musiał, Emilian Zadarko, Maria Zadarko-Domaradzka, Raúl Domínguez
pmc-12526070.description: Introduction: Unhealthy eating habits combined with low levels of physical activity and cardiorespiratory fitness pose a serious threat to the health of young people. The aim of this research was to determine the relationship between selected components of body composition, the occurrence of eating disorders, and cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) and physical activity levels among university students.

pmc-12583170.title: Indications for haematopoietic cell transplantation and CAR-T for haematological diseases, solid tumours and immune disorders: 2025 EBMT practice recommendations
pmc-12583170.creator: R Greco, A Ruggeri, D P McLornan, J A Snowden, T Alexander, E Angelucci, D Averbuch, A Bazarbachi, M D Hazenberg, K Kalwak, M Kenyon, H Mekelenkamp, B Neven, P Pedrazzoli, Z Peric, A M Risitano, I Sánchez-Ortega, F Ciceri, A Sureda
pmc-12583170.description: For over two decades, the EBMT has updated recommendations on indications for haematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) practice based on clinical and scientific developments in the field. This is the ninth special EBMT report on indications for HCT for haematological diseases, solid tumours and immune disorders.

pmc-13000120.title: Polygenic scores in the study of gene–environment interplay and stress-related psychopathology
pmc-13000120.creator: Mehves Kouris, Robert Kumsta
pmc-13000120.description: Polygenic scores (PGS) have become valuable tools for quantifying genetic liability to complex mental disorders. This review discusses the application of PGS in gene–environment interaction (GxE) research, focusing on depression and stress-related phenotypes. We synthesize evidence from studies testing whether genetic risk, as indexed by PGS, moderates the impact of environmental exposures, particularly stressful life events (SLEs), on psychological outcomes.

pmc-13202735.title: Red blood cell distribution width-albumin ratio as predictor of mortality in patients with cardiac disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13202735.creator: Lin Ye, Wei Jiang
pmc-13202735.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to investigate the utility of red blood cell distribution width-albumin ratio (RAR) for predicting mortality in patients with cardiac diseases.MethodsPubMed, Scopus, Embase, and Web of Science databases were systematically searched for studies reporting the association between RAR and mortality in cardiac patients. The search limits were from inception of databases to 20th December 2024.

pmc-13306606.title: Characterization of Atrasentan Metabolic Pathway in Human Liver Microsomes Using Feature-Based Molecular Networking
pmc-13306606.creator: Hyung-Ju Seo, Zhuoning Liang, Eui-Hyeon Kim, Kwang-Hyeon Liu

pmc-13382387.title: Metabolic and textural changes in whiteleg shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei) during frozen storage: Key quality markers revealed by integrated metabolomics and lipidomics
pmc-13382387.creator: Yameng Li, Di Huang, Danhe Wang, Qinxiong Rao, Weiguo Song
pmc-13382387.description: Whiteleg shrimp is prone to quality deterioration during frozen storage, yet the underlying metabolic patterns remain unclear. This study integrated metabolomics and lipidomics using a two-step extraction to elucidate the biochemical basis of texture degradation at −18 °C and − 80 °C. A total of 190 metabolites and 698 lipids were identified, with amino acids and glycerophospholipids predominating.

pmc-13607545.title: Impact of Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria on Major Life-Changing Decisions: An Exploratory Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13607545.creator: Lucía Fuentes-Barragán, Francisco Javier León-Pérez, Raquel Sanabria-de la Torre, Carmen García-Moronta, Alejandro Molina-Leyva, Salvador Arias-Santiago, Trinidad Montero-Vílchez
pmc-13607545.description: Background: Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria (CSU) profoundly impairs health-related quality of life due to intense pruritus and unpredictable flares. However, its specific influence on patients’ major life-changing decisions (MLCD)—such as career choices, family planning, and personal relationships—remains under-researched. This study aimed to evaluate the overall impact of CSU on MLCD and analyze how disease severity modifies these fundamental life trajectories.

pmc-13633564.title: Audiological Profile and Factors Associated With Hearing Impairment Among Adults With Allergic Rhinitis in Tamil Nadu, India: A Hospital-Based Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13633564.creator: Harish Vel V., Neethu Sara George, Arun Kumar G., Neeraj V Mohandas, Thanisha I.
pmc-13633564.description: BackgroundAllergic rhinitis (AR) is a common chronic inflammatory disorder that can adversely affect both middle and inner ear function through Eustachian tube dysfunction (ETD) and cochlear involvement. Despite increasing evidence of auditory complications, hearing impairment among adults with AR remains under-recognized in routine clinical practice.

pmc-13681019.title: Expression of the long noncoding RNA Neat1 in saliva, blood, and ventromedial hypothalamus of pigs exposed to psychosocial stressors
pmc-13681019.creator: Dane Webster, Luoyang Ding, Song Zhang, Darryl D'Souza, Alan Tilbrook, Katelyn Tomas, Sarah Babington, Kate Plush, Dominique Blache, Archa Fox
pmc-13681019.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The long noncoding RNA Nuclear Paraspeckle Assembly Transcript 1 (NEAT1) is a master regulator of transcriptional and posttranscriptional changes in stress responses. Here we assessed Neat1 lncRNA expression using quantitative PCR in peripheral biological fluids (saliva and blood) and a brain region that regulates stress and emotion (ventromedial hypothalamus) of 12‐week‐old pigs exposed to chronic (social mixing causing conflict) and acute (restraint) psychosocial challenges. We demonstrated that Neat1 is measurable in pig saliva, blood, and brain samples.
